name: GB Auto (GB Corp)
source: GB Corp Annual Report 2025, Annual Report 2024 (restated) and Annual Report 2023, consolidated statements of profit or loss
source_note: Figures read from the issuer 4Q/FY25 press release income statement table, in EGP absolute (release prints EGP million). Cost of Sales and Operating Expenses derived from printed lines by identity. PBT less Income Tax equals net profit BEFORE minority interest (2,780.5 mn FY25); the +99.6 mn minority interest line takes it to the 2,880.0 mn net profit the issuer reports as the group bottom line, so that line is stored alongside. EPS derived from Net Profit / 1,085,500,000 shares outstanding per the same release.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)

rows.label: EPS
rows.derivedFrom: Net Profit / 1,085,500,000 shares outstanding (as stated in the release)
rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: the twin keys AUTO and AUTO.CA are one issuer but published different figures for the same period. Neither key is backed by the issuer's own filing, so nothing on file settles which is right and both sides are withheld.

derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
reconciliation_note: Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit does not hold in FY2025, FY2024 because the statement carries items below profit before tax (Minority Interest); the figures are as filed.

merge.source_note: 20261113_2318: FY2023 taken from the RESTATED comparative column of the 2024 Annual Report consolidated statement of profit or loss; FY2022 from the 2023 Annual Report as originally reported. All figures EGP thousands multiplied by 1000 to match this file, which stores EGP units. Net profit is profit attributable to the owners of the parent, matching FY2025 and FY2024. EBIT follows the convention already stored (operating profit plus share of profit of equity accounted investees plus fair value and revaluation items). EPS set to the audited basic earnings per share printed by the issuer for FY2025, FY2024 and FY2023, replacing a derived figure that disagreed with the printed one. FY2022 operating expenses are withheld: the year carries a one-off gain of EGP 8.2bn on disposal and revaluation of an associate, so gross profit less EBIT is not an expense figure for that year.
